dish.title: Thai Yum Nua: Seared Steak Salad with Lime-Chile Dressing and Jasmine Rice
dish.description: Flank steak seared hard in a cast-iron skillet, rested, sliced thin, and tossed warm with cucumber, cherry tomatoes, shallots, scallions, mint, and cilantro in a sharp lime, fish sauce, garlic, and bird chile dressing, piled over romaine with jasmine rice on the side.

recipe_version.title: Thai Yum Nua: Seared Steak Salad with Lime-Chile Dressing and Jasmine Rice
recipe_version.description: Flank steak seared hard in a cast-iron skillet, rested, sliced thin, and tossed warm with cucumber, cherry tomatoes, shallots, scallions, mint, and cilantro in a sharp lime, fish sauce, garlic, and bird chile dressing, piled over romaine with jasmine rice on the side.

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.display_name: fish sauce (anchovy and salt; label lists no shrimp or shellfish)

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice. Cut the steak in half crosswise so it fits the skillet, pat it dry, and season with 1 tsp salt and the pepper. Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, chiles, and garlic in the large bowl until the sugar dissolves. Slice the cucumber, halve the tomatoes, slice the shallots, cut the scallions, pick the mint and cilantro, and separate the romaine leaves.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes. The covered cooking and rest run inside steps 3 to 6 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Sear the steak
steps.body: Heat a 12-inch cast-iron skillet over high until it just smokes, about 4 minutes. Add the oil and the steak and sear without moving it until deeply browned, about 5 minutes per side, until 130 F at the thickest point for medium-rare (or 145 F).

steps.title: Rest
steps.body: Move the steak to the cutting board and rest 5 minutes.

steps.title: Slice and toss
steps.body: Slice the steak thinly against the grain. Add the slices and their juices to the dressing with the cucumber, tomatoes, shallots, and scallions and toss, then fold in the mint and cilantro.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Line a platter with the romaine, pile the salad on top with its dressing, and serve the rice alongside.

coverage_contribution: A fresh beef main salad, a format the catalog has only with chicken (Cobb) and tuna (niçoise). Weeknight time with a hot-sour Thai dressing; Thai meals in the catalog are curries, stir-fries, larb, fish cakes, and grilled skewers.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with thai-turkey-larb-lettuce-wraps: sliced seared steak with tomato and cucumber, not minced turkey with toasted rice in lettuce cups. Compared with gochujang-grilled-flank-steak: a lime-fish sauce herb salad, not a gochujang marinade. Compared with cobb-salad: a hot-sour Thai dressing with herbs, no bacon, egg, or cheese. Compared with argentine-chimichurri-steak-potatoes: sliced steak tossed in a salad with rice, not steak with chimichurri and potatoes.
not_duplicate_of: Not nam tok: no toasted rice powder and no grilling.
